pcs.pc_description: create holes in the water tubes as per the requirement
lay the water tubes in the field as per the plan
secure the water tubes on the ground using ground stakes/ conduit brackets
install emitters/ sprayers/ foggers at the identified spots
set up the irrigation timer
apply cap on the other end of the main tube
connect the main water tube to the water outlet at the farm
connect vacuum breaker with the pressure regulator to prevent backflow of water
install the water-pump at the main water supply
install water filter to prevent silt and dirt from getting in the water tubes
fix flush valves at the identified spots to facilitate regular flushing of any deposits in the water tubes
install the fertigation equipment to deliver water mixed with fertilizers to plants
run clean water through the tubes to remove any dirt and debris inside them
test the micro-irrigation system to see if it functions as expected
perform troubleshooting for any issues identified with the micro-irrigation system
cover the water tubes with soil/ mulch as per the plan
guide the farmer regarding the functioning, minor repair and maintenance and maintenance schedule of the micro-irrigation system
guide the farmer regarding the retrieval of micro-irrigation system after harvesting and installation before planting crop
carry out necessary documentation as per the organisational policy
optimise the usage of water/ electricity/ relevant materials in various tasks and processes
connect the electrical tools and equipment safely and turn off when not in use

pcs.pc_description: examine the emitters for the required level of pressure
check the fertigation system and irrigation timer for correct functioning
remove the flush valves and water tube cap as per the SOP
run clean water through the water tubes to flush any deposits inside them
clean the water filter to remove any blockage inside it
carry out chlorine/ acid treatment to remove salts such carbonates, bi-carbonates, iron, calcium, etc.
set the emitters/ foggers/ sprinklers in the correct position for effective supply of water to the plants
identify damaged or malfunctioning micro- irrigation system components such as emitter, sprayer, fogger, water filter, water-tubes, etc.
replace the damaged or malfunctioning components as per the SOP
maintain the record of maintenance
schedule the next maintenance as per the maintenance schedule
segregate waste into different categories
dispose the non-recyclable waste appropriately
